exceptions.rationale: The deployed Rust bootstrapper uses rsa only for RSA-PSS public-key signature verification. It receives no private key and performs no private-key operation. Local randomized signing keys exist only inside the cfg(test) manifest regression tests; development package signing uses .NET RSA in the local packaging process. The advisory concerns leakage of private-key material through private-key timing. This exception does not permit Rust signing/decryption or externally timed private-key services.
exceptions.mitigation: Preserve raw findings; fail on changed version, expiry or new unreviewed advisories. Review the production crypto call sites whenever this dependency or manifest authentication changes. Replace the implementation before introducing any deployed private-key operation. No patched stable version is available in the reviewed database.
